requirements: VT01: varied forest hairpin, S-bends and sweep
VT02: distinct winding winter circuit with offset chicane
VT03: retain continuous visible loops, three biomes and three tickets

edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied square 3x3 challenge illustration. The owner says the tracks now look too plain after the grass and winter circuits were simplified to ovals.
Primary request: redesign ONLY the TOP GRASS circuit and BOTTOM WINTER circuit into interesting, clearly different race-course shapes, with varied corners, while preserving their obvious continuous closed loops. Keep the middle desert track and exactly THREE foreground racing tickets unchanged in composition and appearance.

TOP GRASS / FOREST circuit: replace the stadium oval with a flowing ASYMMETRIC KIDNEY-SHAPED circuit. Include a tight rounded hairpin at one end, a pronounced sweeping S-bend along the opposite/back stretch, a broad fast corner at the other end and a gently kinked start/finish straight. Make the outline notably concave in two places, so it reads immediately as a proper winding road circuit rather than an oval with decorative kerbs. Let the course weave around small pine groves, grassy rocks and a lake confined to its infield. Strong variety of corner radius and straight length. The upper and lower road branches remain visibly separate with generous green land between them. Its layout should have about 6-8 distinct visible changes of direction.

BOTTOM WINTER circuit: create a distinctly different COMPACT ALPINE ROAD COURSE with an offset S-shaped chicane, one tight 180-degree hairpin, two linked medium-radius corners and a short, clear front start/finish straight. Use an irregular multi-lobed loop rather than a rounded rectangle or stadium oval. Give it roughly 7-9 well-spaced bends, in a believable consistent road width. The road winds around the snowy infield and a small partly frozen lake. Keep infield scenery low and the complete rear road visible. Avoid symmetry with the grass track.

CRITICAL CONTINUITY: each circuit is a SINGLE wide continuous asphalt ribbon around ONE connected infield: a simple unbroken closed ring. Show the entire road surface and both road edges for the complete lap. No gaps, dead ends, branches, intersections, figure-eights, crossings, bridges, tunnels or road segments hidden behind scenery. Never let two stretches touch or merge at an S-bend. Snowbanks, trees, rocks, lakes and guardrails stay off the road and cannot conceal any corner or connection. Every curve must join the next smoothly in the same road width. One checkered start band per circuit remains on its front straight. The route complexity must be apparent in the SHAPE OF THE ROAD, not just new decorations.

Preserve exactly THREE separate vertically stacked scenic islands, forest / warm sand desert / snowy winter, and exactly THREE ivory perforated tickets with the same checkered racing emblems and fully visible outlines. Preserve source scale, high-oblique diorama view, square framing, dark navy backdrop, natural palette, crisp mature cel-shaded materials and restrained lighting. Keep the middle desert circuit as-is. No large mountains or tall infield objects obscuring roads. No vehicles, text, labels, numbers, logos, watermarks or extra objects. Make both revised tracks visibly more winding and varied while remaining easy to trace at small menu-card size. Opaque square image.
edits.review: Varied circuit shapes achieved; vegetation crowds the grass-road connector, so visibility is refined before integration.

edits.prompt:

Make ONE VERY LOCAL correction in the TOP GRASS track only. At the left-third of the grass island, between the rounded left hairpin and the short tight S-bend leading onto the long back stretch, pine trees and vegetation currently hide the connecting road neck. Remove those few intruding/overhanging pine trees and restore the COMPLETE visible grey asphalt ribbon beneath them. The junction-free connector must be smoothly joined from the left hairpin into the S-bend, showing BOTH asphalt edges and the full width of the road without any tree crown, foliage, rock, guardrail or shadow covering the connection. Keep a clear small grass verge along both sides. Do not simplify or straighten the S-bend or hairpin. The entire grass lap must be visually traceable as ONE unbroken winding closed ring, with no gap, dead end, fork, crossing or overlapping road. Move no other part of the course.

Keep EVERYTHING ELSE unchanged: the new varied grass-track shape, its big sweep and front start straight, all other forest/lake scenery away from this connector, the entire middle desert circuit, the entire newly winding winter circuit, its S-bends and chicane, all THREE tickets exactly as they are, three islands, style, colour palette, scale, square framing and opaque navy background. No text, logos or additional objects. This is only a visibility cleanup of the obscured grass-road connector.
edits.review: Forest hairpin and sweeping S-bends have an exposed continuous connector. Winter has an asymmetric winding back stretch and an offset front chicane. All three circuits form readable closed loops; three tickets remain.
